verdict.rationale: xAI's public pricing page lists input, cached-input and output prices per 1M tokens for each model in USD (e.g. grok-4.7 at $2.00/$0.50/$6.00) and states the long-context billing rule. Signup and credit loading are self-serve with no sales contact, and GET /v1/models also returns per-model pricing programmatically. Missing for 10: evidence that pricing covers every current non-text model (image, video, voice), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the published prices.
